evaluation.results_summary: The model card reports zero-shot performance on a selection of natural language tasks, with scores listed for LAMBADA, SciQ, PIQA, TriviaQA, and ARC.
evaluation.safety_evals: The model card cautions that GPT-NeoX-20B may generate socially unacceptable or undesirable text even when the prompt is not explicitly offensive.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: base language model trained on general web text with no fine-tuning for factual tasks; card reports only task scores and cautions about undesirable text, so it can produce factually inaccurate content.

possible_risks.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.
possible_risks.justification: 20B-parameter dense decoder-only model trained on the Pile; training a model of this scale plausibly has carbon and water impacts.

specifications.model_size: 38.5 GiB of safetensors weights (41,293,763,742 bytes) in F16

training_context.adaptations: GPT-NeoX-20B has not been fine-tuned for downstream tasks such as genre prose or commercial chatbots.
training_context.training_data: GPT-NeoX-20B was trained on the Pile, an English-language general-purpose dataset.
